bibl.title: Relating Introspective Accuracy to Individual Differences in Brain Structure

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: Individual differences in metacognitive sensitivity - how well a person's confidence tracks their own correctness - and whether those differences sit in brain structure.
span.quote: We dissociated variation in introspective ability from objective performance in a simple perceptual decision task, allowing us to determine whether this inter-individual variability was associated with a distinct neural substrate.

span.label: existence
span.quote: We show that introspective ability is correlated with gray matter volume in anterior prefrontal cortex, a region which shows striking evolutionary development in humans.

span.label: metacognitive sensitivity
span.quote: In this context, introspective or “metacognitive” sensitivity refers to the ability to discriminate correct from incorrect perceptual decisions ( 1 ), and its accuracy is essential for the appropriate guidance of decision making and action ( 2 , 3 ).

span.label: structural-mri
span.quote: We objectively quantified variability in metacognitive sensitivity between individuals, and then related these inter-individual differences to brain structure measured using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: anterior prefrontal cortex supports introspective accuracy by carrying out second-order operations that integrate supramodal perceptual information with the decision output, thereby linking performance to confidence
span.quote: Anterior subdivisions of prefrontal cortex have been implicated in high-level control of cognition ( 19 , 20 , 26 , 27 ), and are well placed to integrate supramodal perceptual information with decision output ( 28 ), a process thought to be key for metacognitive sensitivity

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: metacognitive ability depends not only on local prefrontal grey matter but on the integrity of the reciprocal fibre projections running into and out of that region
span.quote: consistent with metacognitive ability being dependent not only on anterior prefrontal grey matter but also on reciprocal projections to and from this area.

span.label: Holding objective performance constant by staircasing difficulty per participant isolates metacognitive variation from perceptual variation
span.quote: The difficulty of the visual judgement was varied on a per-participant basis in order to keep performance at a constant level (71%), near sensory threshold.

span.label: Type II ROC turns trial-by-trial confidence ratings into a single individual-level number, which is what makes a structural correlation possible at all
span.quote: These ratings were used to determine metacognitive ability at an individual level through the construction of Type II receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves ( 21 - 23 ) ( Fig. 2A ).

span.label: Anterior prefrontal cortex is proposed as the site because it performs second-order operations on internally generated information, which is what metacognition requires
span.quote: Theories of prefrontal function have emphasised a role for anterior (rostrolateral) prefrontal cortex in carrying out second-order operations on internally generated information ( 19 , 20 ), a core feature of metacognition.

span.label: The white matter result is predicted from the grey matter one rather than found independently: if the region matters, its connections should too
span.quote: If the structure of anterior prefrontal cortex is functionally related to metacognitive performance, we hypothesised that white matter tracts connected with this region would also show a similar microstructural correlation with expression of this behavioural trait.

span.label: The tract implicated carries fibres to and from exactly the prefrontal regions identified in the grey matter analysis, which is what makes the two results one result
span.quote: This specific subdivision of the corpus callosum contains white matter fibres connected with the anterior and orbital prefrontal cortices in humans ( 25 ), consistent with metacognitive ability being dependent not only on anterior prefrontal grey matter but also on reciprocal projections to and from this area.

span.label: The design is correlational and cannot establish that the brain-structure/metacognition covariation is causal.
span.quote: As with any correlational method, we cannot establish whether the covariation we observed here between brain structure and metacognition reflects a causal role.

span.label: The absence of structural correlates for objective performance and confidence bias may be an artefact of a design that deliberately minimised variability in those measures.
span.quote: We note that an absence of structural correlations with these parameters may have been due to our design deliberately minimising variability in both d’ and B roc in order to isolate the neural correlates of introspective ability ( A roc ).

span.label: The authors state plainly that the method cannot establish causation
span.quote: As with any correlational method, we cannot establish whether the covariation we observed here between brain structure and metacognition reflects a causal role.

span.label: Thirty-two participants, for whole-brain structural correlations with a behavioural trait
span.quote: We studied 32 healthy human participants while they made a series of visual judgements ( 21 ).

span.label: The design deliberately suppressed variance in performance and confidence bias, so the absence of structural correlates for those may be a consequence of the design rather than a finding
span.quote: We note that an absence of structural correlations with these parameters may have been due to our design deliberately minimising variability in both d’ and B roc in order to isolate the neural correlates of introspective ability ( A roc ).

span.label: The left-hemisphere homologue and a second temporal cluster did not survive whole-brain correction and are reported in supplementary tables
span.quote: Gray matter volume in a homologous region in left anterior prefrontal cortex was also correlated with A roc , but did not survive correction for multiple comparisons across the brain volume.

span.label: Whether the anatomy is innate or the trace of experience is left open, and the two have very different implications
span.quote: Our present findings may reflect innate differences in anatomy, or alternatively reflect the effects of experience and learning, as has been found in the sensorimotor domain ( 14 , 15 ).

span.label: control analyses re-running the structural correlation while holding stimulus contrast - the staircase's converged value - constant
span.quote: We therefore carried out control analyses ( 21 ) ( table S4 ) to rule out this alternative explanation.

span.label: metacognitive ability - as an INDIVIDUAL-level trait: one number per person, which is the only level at which a structural correlation can be computed
span.quote: Our design dissociated a quantitative measure of metacognitive accuracy, A roc (which is specific to an individual) from both objective task performance and subjective confidence (which both vary on a trial-by-trial basis).

span.label: confidence - as a TRIAL-level rating: what participants report after each decision, and the raw material rather than the measure
span.quote: As well as asking participants to make these objective perceptual judgements, we also asked them to provide ratings of confidence in their decisions following each trial ( Fig. 1 ).

span.label: metacognition - sensitivity (A roc): how well confidence separates correct from incorrect, the quantity of interest
span.quote: The area between the major diagonal and an individual’s ROC curve is a measure of the ability to link confidence to perceptual performance ( A roc ).

span.label: metacognition - bias (B roc): the tendency to use high or low confidence overall, which is a different thing and was checked to be uncorrelated
span.quote: Our analysis examined the possible relationship between brain structure and four different measures: the metacognitive ability ( A roc ) of our participants, objective performance on the perceptual task ( d’ and c ), and the tendency to use high or low confidence responses on individual trials ( B roc ) ( 21 ).

span.label: performance - objective (d’): how accurate the perceptual decisions were, deliberately held near constant so it cannot explain the result
span.quote: We found considerable variation across individuals in metacognitive ability ( A roc = 0.55 – 0.75) despite underlying task performance being held constant (proportion correct: 70 – 74%); furthermore, these measures were uncorrelated (Pearson’s r = − 0.11, P = 0.56).

span.label: supports → lesion studies showing deficits in subjective report after anterior prefrontal damage
span.quote: Consistent with prefrontal grey matter volume playing a causal role in metacognition, patients with lesions to anterior prefrontal cortex show deficits in subjective reports compared to controls, after factoring out differences in objective performance ( 16 ).

span.label: supports → theta-burst TMS work showing metacognitive sensitivity can be impaired while performance is spared
span.quote: Furthermore, impairing dorsolateral prefrontal cortex function with theta-burst transcranial magnetic stimulation compromises the metacognitive sensitivity of subjective reports of awareness, while leaving underlying task performance intact ( 30 ).

span.label: extends → the body of work linking individual differences in language, decision making and memory to healthy brain anatomy
span.quote: This approach was motivated by observations that individual differences in a range of skills, such as language ( 11 ), decision making ( 12 ) and memory ( 13 ), are consistently associated with variation in healthy brain anatomy.
